what: A judgment rejected for a made-up quote still counted as answered, so a document could show Ready with an unanswered criterion.
fix: Only a valid judgment marks a criterion answered; a rejected one leaves it in 'missing', which blocks Ready.
rule_added: review-doc/SKILL.md: a rejected judgment is re-asked, never dropped

caught_by: review-doc judgment pass (fresh-context agent), outside the rubric
what: The brief said 'MVP 1 is due before the panel session (date to confirm)': an unknown not written as `confirm — <who>, by <date>`. check_doc.py C03/C04 only look for TBD-style blanks and malformed `confirm —`, so a free-text '(to confirm)' passed the rule checks.
fix: Pending: send the brief back to frame-problem for v2. Proposed rule: C03 also flags 'to confirm' / 'to be confirmed' / 'unknown' that is not a `confirm —` placeholder.

caught_by: review-doc judgment pass on v2 (fresh-context agent), outside the rubric
what: A rule-checks-only run of check_doc.py rewrites reviews/<doc>.review.json with no judgments, wiping the previous judged findings. After v2 edits the maker's self-check erased the v1 review, so since_last_run came back null and the v1 findings survive only in the v1 run report and the scratchpad judgments.
fix: Rule-only runs now write <doc>.rules.*; only judged runs write <doc>.review.*, and since_last_run compares judged review to judged review (also when the previous review had no findings). Owner approved 2026-11-23.
rule_added: review-doc/SKILL.md: "A self-check can't erase a review"; test_check_doc.py: review history test

caught_by: review-doc judgment pass on v2 (fresh-context agent), outside the rubric
what: A rule-checks-only run prints 'Ready … judgments not run', but SKILL.md says Ready needs every criterion answered.
fix: A rule-only run reports "Rules pass" or "Needs work"; only a judged run with every criterion answered can say Ready. Owner approved 2026-11-23.
rule_added: check_doc.py status logic; examples/expected.json perfect fixtures now expect "Rules pass"

caught_by: review-doc judgment pass on v4 (fresh-context agent), outside the rubric
what: check_doc.py writes a multi-line `suggested` value into .review.md without indenting it, so a suggested table row renders outside its bullet. Cosmetic.
fix: Pending: indent each continuation line of `suggested` and `quote` under its bullet.

caught_by: owner + maker, across five fresh-context reviews
what: Each fresh reviewer finds one new Check (v3, v4 and v5 each ended Fix 0 · Check 1 on a different point), because a cold read always surfaces another missing assumption row. Without a stopping rule the loop never ends on its own.
fix: Pending (owner's call): the lifecycle says when to stop. After two consecutive judged runs with Fix 0 and only Check findings, the maker recommends the gate, and the remaining Checks are carried to the next stage's open questions instead of another version.
